title: Mindray Fully Automatic Biochemistry Analzyer BS-240
desc: BS-240 is a CUTE , multi-functional benchtop chemistry analyzer with a throughput of 200 tests per hour. Though with a compact size, it has achieved a host of advanced functions never before found on alike products in the market, making it an optimal chemistry solution for small laboratories and a back-up tool for mid-to-high volume laboratories.
